$source: Canva design DAG-MAUycaM — "OFWT 32x9 - Multi-design" (8 pages). Values read from the live Canva DOM, not eyeballed.

orange.use: Sun, skyline illustration, 'SG' badge on navy

offwhite.use: Text on navy ('OFW', 'Tambayan', tagline, event copy)

royalBlue.use: 'OFW'/'OFWT'/hashtag text + tagline on light pages; 'SG' badge fill

yellow.use: Script text fill on light pages ('Tambayan', 'Kamusta ka ba?', etc.)

strokeRed.use: 12px outline around yellow script text on light pages

eventPanel.use: Skewed translucent info panel on page 2 (renders ≈ #46517F over navy)

light.use: Pages 4–8 have no background fill (made for transparent export); use white/#F6F7F9 on web

script.use: 'Tambayan', 'Kamusta ka ba?', 'Share Ko Lang', 'Share Mo Lang'
script.note: Not licensable for web. Keep it baked into logo images; for live text try Google 'Caveat Brush' or 'Kalam' 700 as the nearest free look.

typeScale.$note: Canva design units on the 32:9 page. Use as proportions, not literal px.

effects.scriptOnNavy: Fill #F5F4F4 with a 14px #27346B stroke layer underneath (knock-out outline where it overlaps the 'W')
effects.scriptOnLight: Fill #F9D21D with a 12px #CE2029 stroke layer underneath
effects.groundShadow: Soft dark ellipse under the skyline (assets/elements/ground-shadow.png)
